title: Question 6.1c: Multiple Metrics Calculation
instruction: Different metrics tell us different things about how the model performs. This code calculates several metrics to get a complete picture.
reveal: This code calculates four different metrics: accuracy (overall correctness), precision (how reliable positive predictions are), recall (how many positive cases were found), and F1 (a combined measure). Each metric tells us something different. For example, a model might have high accuracy but poor recall (missing many positive reviews), so we need multiple metrics to understand the full picture.
